hero.line: Mechanical Engineering, Design, Rapid Prototyping, Integration and Innovation

about.heading: About Me
paragraphs: Hello, my name is Ahmad Salman. I am aquiring a Masters of Integrated Innovative Products and Services program with my previous background being in Mechanical Engineering with a minor in Design at Carnegie Mellon. I study complex and diverse topics hoping to combine engineering and design into better mechanical design.
I want to be on the forefront of new waves of technology and work with brilliant minds to usher in transformative technologies that have helped change my life.

entries.title: Carnegie Mellon University

lines.left: Master of Integrated Innovation for Products and Services
Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering, Minor in Design

entries.note: Relevant Coursework: Integrated Product Design | Mechanical Design | Dynamics | Moonshot Thinking | User Research

entries.title: Manufacturing Intern | Eaton
bullets: Created over 20 work instructions with engineers to reflect current practices and safety standards in manufacturing
Collaborated with teams across production, safety, and manufacturing process improvements with 5S+ protocols
Designed custom tools for manufacturing using SolidWorks, and worked with shop technicians to increase efficiency
Optimized the SMT manufacturing assembly process saving $50K+ through quality tests and reducing material waste

entries.title: Mechanical Design Intern | Jaros Baum and Bolles
bullets: Developed 15+ technical drawings on potential floorplans with new HVAC systems for commercial and residential buildings through Revit to comply with industry standards

Oversaw mechanical design revisions and technical documentation using Bluebeam and AutoCAD to recommend cost-effective equipment to maximize customer satisfaction, including conducting onsite visits and maintenance reports

entries.title: Accessibility-Based Smart Glasses | Personal Research
bullets: Led end-to-end development of an affordable wearable for older adults experiencing both age-related hearing and vision loss, iterating on different housing designs doing material and cost analysis between TPU, ABS, and PLA

Conducted PESTLE analysis, market research, and user profiles across over 40 adults ages 65+ with degenerative conditions identifying rising rates of age-based diseases such as macular degeneration and hearing impairment
Evaluated FFT-based and time-domain approaches to real-time audio enhancement through AI-assisted prototyping,

entries.title: Expandable Suitcase | Product Design
bullets: Owned rapid mechanical design and prototyping of a functional expandable hard-shell suitcase with $300 budget
Iterated prototypes with SolidWorks and GD&T achieving 23% volume increase meeting TSA constraints upon use
Designed a telescoping rod pin-lock mechanism allowing for only .233 pound-force to deploy activation of expansion

entries.title: Red Rover | Mechanical Design: Methods and Applications
bullets: Designed a rover for those suffering mobility issues using SolidWorks and 3D-printed with PETG filament, capable of lifting and transporting objects, achieving a 50-pound max load verified using ANSYS for load analysis
Engineered a functional conveyor belt and base for object intake and deposit, programmed in Python for activation

entries.title: Resident Advisor | Carnegie Mellon University
bullets: Provided support and guidance to students, supervised over 500 residents, and resolved emergency situations
Hosted weekly events to promote student belonging and well-being with documented summaries with resident data

entries.title: Vice President | SPIRIT (Black Student Union)
bullets: Facilitated weekly body meetings, and coordinated events to build 15+ unique experiences for the general student body

entries.title: Pre-College Initiate Chair | National Society of Black Engineers (NSBE)
bullets: Organized 40+ K-12 students to teach about STEM, by introducing speakers, facilitating Q&As, and connecting faculty

entries.title: Mechanic | SPIRIT Racing Systems
bullets: Diagnosed and repaired disk brake systems on a carbon-fiber, non-motorized racing buggy, ensuring reliable stopping performance through varied race conditions dealing with rain and rough terrain at speeds upwards of 25 mph
